note: Total population — census enumeration is the headline; WB SP.POP.TOTL is a modeled estimate.
Population growth rate — headline is the census intercensal rate; WB SP.POP.GROW is modeled.
Population density — headline is census; WB EN.POP.DNST is derived from its modeled population.
Female population — headline is the census sex-disaggregated count; WB is modeled.
Male population — headline is the census sex-disaggregated count; WB is modeled.
Literacy — headline is the census literate-population count (age 5+). NOTE the WB series SE.ADT.LITR.ZS is ADULT (15+) literacy — a different age base — so it is a related alternative estimate
